verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a video-extension feature or a way to regenerate a single segment of an existing clip. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: mask-based local re-editing is scoped to Image 3.0 Omni (images, not video), 'video input' pricing does not say it extends clips, and 'refine and edit your videos through multiple rounds of post-production' does not describe partial re-rendering.
